### FMT BYTES
Returns a human-readable representation of a byte count using binary (base-1024) units.
For example, `1536` becomes `"1.5kb"`.
Supported units: `b`, `kb`, `mb`, `gb`, `tb`, `pb`.

```esql
ROW bytes = 1536
| EVAL formatted = FMT_BYTES(bytes)
```
